intents.name: theme_customization
intents.answer: To customize app theme and appearance: Go to Settings > Appearance. You can toggle between Dark Mode, Light Mode, or Sync with System Theme. You can also choose custom accent colors, chat wallpapers, and font scale.

intents.name: advertisements_tab_location
intents.answer: To access your Ad Account, view existing promotional campaigns, or create new ad banners: Navigate to Dashboard → Settings → Advertisements tab. Here you can track ad review status, view performance analytics, and fund your ad campaign balance.

intents.name: pwa_app_installation
intents.answer: NoteStandard can be installed as a standalone app on iOS, Android, Windows, and Mac: On Android/Desktop Chrome, tap the 'Install App' icon in the browser address bar. On iPhone/iPad Safari, tap the Share button and select 'Add to Home Screen'. Installing the PWA provides full-screen performance and instant push notifications.

intents.name: notification_preferences
intents.answer: Manage notification alerts in Settings > Notifications. Customize push alerts, email digests, chat sound effects, and in-app banner preferences for messages, wallet transactions, team invites, and mentions.

intents.name: language_localization
intents.answer: NoteStandard is localized in multiple languages including English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Arabic, and Chinese. Change your app language under Settings > Language & Region.

intents.name: privacy_controls
intents.answer: Control your data and visibility under Settings > Privacy: Toggle online presence visibility, read receipt status, public profile indexing, and search discoverability.

intents.name: app_version_update
intents.answer: To check your current app version or search for updates, go to Settings > About NoteStandard > Check for Updates. On web, simply refresh your browser window to fetch the latest version.
